To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the MSS technology and design toolset can enable the integration of logic, memory, analog, and RF functions on a single chip for IoT applications.
the STT MRAM is the most suitable technology for IoT applications due to its high speed, low power, and high integration densities.
we have demonstrated that a single MTJ technology can be used for logic, analog, and memory applications, and we have developed the first process design kit for this technology.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following aspects: (1) The technology, (2) The process design kit (PDK), (3) Standard cell library design, (4) Memory design and evaluation and (5) System level design exploration.

(i) technology development, including the integration of the MTJ into CMOS and the integration of the CMOS into the MTJ; (ii) modeling and simulation of the MTJ; and (iii) design and evaluation of the MTJ-based standard cells and circuits.
developing new technology, design methodologies, and architectures for future IoT systems.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the project has made significant progress in the design, modeling and evaluation of MSS based logic and memory, as well as analog and mixed signal functions.
the project has successfully developed a technology and toolsets for the design, modeling, and exploration of the multifunctional standard cell technology for IoT.

the EU GREAT project has successfully demonstrated a new universal spintronic platform for IoT, and that the proposed technology is a giant leap towards heterogeneous integrated technology, and architectures for the future of IoT.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the MSS technology is a promising solution for future IoT applications.

the project has successfully demonstrated the feasibility of using MSS as a universal spintronic platform for IoT, and the proposed technology and toolset are ready for further exploration and evaluation in the IoT domain.
we are on the way to develop a novel universal technology platform for IoT, which can be easily integrated with other CMOS technologies, and can be used to build various types of IoT systems.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the MSS cell technology is a viable solution for IoT applications, with a potential of 10X reduction in power consumption and area.
the MSS technology is the first step towards the ultimate heterogeneous integration of logic and memory.

the MSS technology can be used for monolithic heterogeneous integration of digital and analog functions, fast yet low-power processing and storage, high integration density, and a wide range of applications, particularly for IoT.
